content: 1. This approach involves regular monitoring and scheduled check-ins, particularly for patients who require more comprehensive and individualized care plans. 2. The implementation of Electronic Health Records (EHR) facilitates improved tracking and analysis of patient data. This enables healthcare providers to identify trends in diabetes management and pinpoint specific areas that require intervention or improvement. 3. Reducing financial barriers is critical to ensuring that patients have access to essential resources. This includes diabetes education programs, routine examinations, and necessary medications, all without the prohibitive burden of high costs. 4. Expanding telehealth services enhances accessibility to diabetes care, especially for individuals living in rural or underserved areas.
